title: EM / RF HYGIENE ONBOARD SUBMARINES CHECK OFF LISTS

sections.title: EM / RF HYGIENE ONBOARD SUBMARINES CHECK OFF LISTS

fields_1.name: sub_gr_a
fields_1.label: (a) When was the last major refit (NR and above) undertaken and pre and post refit survey carried out?

fields_1.name: sub_gr_b
fields_1.label: (b) When did Naval EMC Centre undertake the last EMI / EMC survey?

fields_1.name: sub_gr_c
fields_1.label: (c) Were any modifications / A's and A's carried out on any electrical / electronic equipment since last survey? If yes, indicate details and authority, and whether NEC comments / recommendations were obtained during feasibility study.

fields_1.name: sub_gr_d
fields_1.label: (d) Any EMI problems encountered since the last survey? If yes, state the EMI problems.

cells.value: (a) Loose metallic items inside casing properly secured
(b) Cables running inside casing properly routed through conduits
(c) Cable screens / conduits bonded 360 degrees at pressure hull penetration point
(d) Radar antenna and INMARSAT radomes marked "DO NOT PAINT"
(e) All porcelain insulators free from paint, grease and varnish
(a) RF paint on communication antenna in good condition
(b) RF paint on radar antenna in good condition
(c) Any RF leakage at wave-guide joints outside radar mast
(d) Degradation of VSWR value vis-a-vis previous HATS and SATS measurements
(e) All gaskets of RF cabinets in good condition
(f) Connectors / wave-guide junctions tight and properly preserved
(g) Wave-guides and antenna feeder cables in good physical condition
(a) Equipment / machinery above 30V provided with proper grounding
(b) Copper straps provided for steel cabinets/foundations grounding
(c) Aluminum alloy straps provided for aluminum cabinets/foundations
(d) Braided Type IV ground straps for equipment on shock mounts
(e) Bond straps free from corrosion, breakage and loose contacts
(f) Bond resistance within limits (less than 10 milli ohms)
(g) Portable equipment with three-core cables grounded using third pin
(h) Covers / panels of electronic equipment secured
(i) If wooden/plastic platforms used, grounding provision provided for fitted equipment
(j) Ethernet / LAN cables are STP and not UTP
(k) Slip rings, brushes and brush tension proper in DC motors
(l) Power line filters for Radio/Radar rooms properly bonded to hull
(m) Metallic doors of Cat A compartments make proper all-around contact with frame
(n) Pigtail bonds used for grounding of cable screens are in good condition
(o) 360 degree cable shield termination inside connectors maintained in good condition
(p) Cable shields / pipelines / ventilation ducts penetrating radio room bulkhead grounded at penetration
(q) In SSK submarines, power supply lines from suppressor filters to radio room bulkhead routed in flexible metal conduits
(r) HF Rx feeder cables routed through narrow band pass filters mounted on radio room bulkhead
(s) Feeder cable routing and bonding condition satisfactory
